questions.q: Who wrote the classic Indian epic 'Meghadoota'?
questions.x: 'Meghadoota' (The Cloud Messenger) is attributed to the ancient Sanskrit poet Kalidas.

questions.q: Which of these is a famous work by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay?
questions.x: Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay authored all three: *Anandamath*, *Durgeshnandini*, and *Kapalkundala*.

questions.q: Who is the author of the famous play 'Abhijnanashakuntalam'?
questions.x: 'Abhijnanashakuntalam' (The Recognition of Shakuntala) is a classic Sanskrit play by Kalidas.

questions.q: Which book is NOT written by Rabindranath Tagore?
questions.x: *Anandamath* was written by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay, not Tagore.

questions.q: Who wrote the famous Persian work 'Akbarnama'?
questions.x: *Akbarnama* is a historical chronicle of Akbar's reign written by Abul Fazl.

questions.q: Which of these is a work by Munshi Premchand?
questions.x: *Godan* is a famous novel by Munshi Premchand, depicting rural Indian life.

questions.q: Who authored the famous travelogue 'Twilight in Delhi'?
questions.x: *Twilight in Delhi* was written by **Sir Charles Metcalfe**, a British administrator.

questions.q: Which book is NOT part of the 'Panchatantra' collection?
questions.x: *Hitopadesha* is a separate collection of fables by Vishnu Sharma, not part of *Panchatantra*.

questions.q: Which of these dynasties established the city of Vijayanagara?
questions.x: The Vijayanagara Empire was founded by the Sangama brothers in the 14th century, giving the city its name.

questions.q: The 'Ashokan Pillar' at Sarnath has inscriptions in which script?
questions.x: The Ashokan pillars, including the one at Sarnath, use the Brahmi script for their inscriptions.

questions.q: Which of these rulers was known as 'Lichchavi Dauhitra'?
questions.x: Harshavardhana was called 'Lichchavi Dauhitra' due to his marriage into the Lichchavi royal family.

questions.q: The 'Kailasa Temple' at Ellora was built by which dynasty?
questions.x: The Rashtrakuta king Krishna I commissioned the Kailasa Temple, carved out of a single rock.

questions.q: Which of these was a port city under the Chola Empire?
questions.x: Kaveripattinam (modern-day Poompuhar) was a major Chola port city and trade center.

questions.q: The 'Iron Pillar' at Delhi is believed to have been built by which ruler?
questions.x: The Iron Pillar is traditionally attributed to King Anangapala of the Tomara dynasty (4th–5th century CE).

questions.q: Which of these texts was written by Banabhatta?
questions.x: Banabhatta, a court poet of Harshavardhana, wrote *Harshacharita*, a biography of the emperor.

questions.q: The 'Nalanda University' was destroyed by which invader?
questions.x: Bakhtiyar Khalji, a Turkic general, sacked Nalanda University in 1193 CE, destroying its libraries and structures.
